LEGO City Undercover - The Chase Begins.name: LEGO City Undercover: The Chase Begins
LEGO City Undercover - The Chase Begins.summary: LEGO City Undercover: The Chase Begins. A prequel to the Wii U game, follow the exploits of Chase McCain as a rookie cop. Find out how the story of Chase McCain begins. Chase McCain is on his first assignment as a police offer-and it's up to you to help him clean up LEGO City! By changing into different disguises, Chase has access to unique abilities, such as putting out fires as a Fireman and breaking open doors as a Robber. After using his skills to infiltrate criminal organizations, help Chase finish the job by slapping cuffs on the bad guys. With multiple areas of LEGO City to explore and a boatload of LEGO Bricks and Studs to collect, the chase has most certainly begun.

Rayman and Rabbids Family Pack.name: Rayman and Rabbids Family Pack
Rayman and Rabbids Family Pack.summary: The Rayman and Rabbids Family Pack is a compilation of games from the Rayman series and Rabbids series. The pack includes Rayman Origins, Rabbids Rumble and Rabbids 3D. It was released exclusively for the Nintendo 3DS on October 2, 2014 in Europe only.
